content.title: ‘XO, Kitty’ Season 3 – release date, schedule, how to watch
content.text: Season 3 of "XO, Kitty" has landed on Netflix, following Kitty's final year at KISS. With her perfect senior year all planned out, she intends to make it memorable and connect with her relatives in Korea as well as plan the next part of her future.Of course, it won't all be smooth sailing, but, as per the Jenny Han playbook, there is sure to be a heartfelt ending to tie it all up.XO, Kitty. (L to R) Sang Heon Lee as Min Ho Moon, Anna Cathcart as Kitty Song Covey in episode 308 of XO, Kitty. Cr. Courtesy of Netflix © 2026. (Netf... | Courtesy of Netflix'XO, Kitty' Season 3 Release Date"XO, Kitty" Season 3 will be available to stream on Netflix on April 2, 2026.All episodes of "XO, Kitty" Season 3 will land on Netflix at once.Will All Episodes of 'XO, Kitty' Season 3 Be Released at Once?Yes. All eight episodes of "XO, Kitty" Season 3 will be available to stream on Netflix from April 2.'XO, Kitty' Season 3 – How to Watch"XO, Kitty" Season 3 will be available on Netflix from 12 a.m. PT/3 a.m. ET on April 2, 2026.A Netflix subscription is required to stream Season 3 of "XO, Kitty". A standard subscription with ads is $7.99 per month, and a standard no-ads subscription starts at $17.99 per month.What Time Does 'XO, Kitty' Season 3 Come Out?"XO, Kitty" Season 3 will debut on Netflix at 12 a.m. PT/3 a.m. ET.Here is when "XO, Kitty" Season 3 will be available to stream in different time zones:April 2BRT: 4:00 amBST: 8:00 amCEST: 9:00 amIST: 12:30 pmJST: 4:00 pmAET: 5:00 pmNZDT: 7:00 pm'XO, Kitty' Season 3 Release ScheduleAll eight episodes of "XO, Kitty" Season 3 will be released on April 2.What Will Happen in 'XO, Kitty' Season 3?The official synopsis for Season 3 of "XO, Kitty," as per Netflix, reads, "Kitty Song Covey returns for her final year at KISS with her perfect senior year mapped out. She's going to make meaningful memories with her friends, grow closer to her relatives in Korea, and make big decisions about her future. And she's going to define her relationship with Min Ho. For real this time. But when surprise revelations throw her plans, and relationships, off course, Kitty will have to learn to embrace the unexpected."How Many Episodes Will 'XO, Kitty' Season 3 Have?Season 3 of "XO, Kitty" will have eight episodes.'XO, Kitty' Season 3 Episode TitlesEpisode 1: Guest ListEpisode 2: Sunset ListEpisode 3: Play ListEpisode 4: A ListEpisode 5: Off the ListEpisode 6: Wait ListEpisode 7: Best Dressed ListEpisode 8: Wish List(as per Netflix)Will There Be a Season 4 of 'XO, Kitty'?A fourth season of "XO, Kitty" is yet to be confirmed.When Will Season 4 of 'XO, Kitty' Be Released?There is no confirmation of whether or not there'll be a Season 4 of "XO, Kitty."
